title: 第25章 呼吸法第26章 高文俊的阳谋
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
苍云门炼药堂。
今天林潜早早就到了药房，陈医师来到药房时，林潜为昨天缺席向陈医师道歉，并表示以后不会再缺席。
陈医师看到林潜的状态比之前好了很多，微微一笑，摆摆手，毫不在意林潜昨天缺席的事。
接着陈医师左手拿起一味药材，右手指着其根须，为林潜讲解其不同的用法。
林潜一脸专注，时不时点头，偶尔会提些问题。
两人就在这样的氛围里，一个人教，一个人学。
时间缓慢而坚定的流逝，等陈医师回过神来，已临近午时。
陈医师看见阳光已透过窗户照射到脚边，知道时间不早了，说道：“好了，今天就先讲到这里，你去吃饭吧。”
“谢谢陈老的教导。”
林潜站起来，朝着陈医师鞠躬道。
接着林潜收拾好各种药材，走出药房，转身轻轻地关上了房门。
陈医师每次给林潜讲解各种医道知识都有一种酣畅淋漓之感，又带着意犹未尽之感。
他对林潜是非常满意的。
林潜是他平生遇到的最有天赋最有悟性的学徒。
只要是他讲过的内容，林潜一遍就能牢牢记住。
甚至不仅是记住，林潜还能触及旁类，举一反三。
这样的学徒他能不满意吗？陈医师觉得林潜不出几年医术就能超越他。
之前陈医师觉得刘堂主让他一年内培养出一名医师出来，是无稽之谈。
但林潜的惊艳表现，一年培养出一名医师出来也未尝不可。
再想到自己教儿孙医术时的场景，陈医师眉头不由深深皱起。

他不厌其烦的教孙子医术，可孙子就是记不住，就算当时记住了，第二天醒来就忘得一干二净。
像是在对牛弹琴一般，简直朽木不可雕啊。
“要是平儿有小林一半的天赋，甚至两三成的天赋，我也有信心将平儿教成合格医师。”
“唉！
可惜平儿怎么就这么愚笨呢，医道天赋一点都不随我，和他爹一样。”
陈医师摇了摇头，叹了口气，也朝着房间外走去。
林潜离开炼药堂后，先去饭堂吃过午饭，接着在树林中修炼无影针。
无影针快要突破到三阶了，所以他重心暂时放在了修炼无影针上。
......
传功堂五层楼塔。
林潜正在大殿里翻阅书籍。
大殿里不仅有各种武功秘籍，还有一些记录武道修炼常识性的书籍。
而林潜正在翻看这些书籍，上面有记录人体穴道、经脉分布讲解，有记录突破淬体境各个阶段身体的不同变化，有记录一些奇花异草的书籍，也有一些前辈外出游历的传记。
林潜翻遍了全部书籍，都没有找到他想了解的。
无奈之下，林潜又转到放武功秘籍的书架旁。
虽然这不是林潜第一次来，但再次看到这些武功秘籍，他的心还是激动不已，恨不得将这些秘籍全部都学了。
可惜只能想想。
眼看时间差不多了，林潜朝着大殿门外而去。
自从上次他来这里，因出来的太晚，被司徒长老训了一顿。
为此林潜专门找人打听过，这里下午五点就关闭了，而大殿门口的老者，弟子们都称呼为司徒长老。

看周围已没有其他弟子了，林潜朝着司徒长老走去。
“哟，这不是练绣花针的小子嘛？”
“怎么？，绣花针练得不过瘾？打算换本功法继续放松放松？”
司徒长老看似在闭目养神，可周围的一举一动都在他的掌控之中。
司徒长老早就注意到林潜了，他对林潜还是有印象的。
content_en:
Cangyunmen Medicine Refining Hall.
Lin Qian arrived at the pharmacy early today. When Dr. Chen came to the pharmacy, Lin Qian apologized to Dr. Chen for his absence yesterday and said he would not be absent again in the future.
Dr. Chen saw that Lin Qian's condition was much better than before. He smiled slightly and waved his hand, not caring about Lin Qian's absence yesterday.
Then Dr. Chen picked up a medicinal material with his left hand, pointed at its roots with his right hand, and explained its different uses to Lin Qian.
Lin Qian looked attentive, nodding from time to time, and occasionally asking questions.
The two of them were in such an atmosphere, one taught and the other learned.
Time passed slowly but surely, and by the time Dr. Chen came to his senses, it was already approaching noon.
Dr. Chen saw that the sun was shining through the window and reached his feet. He knew that it was getting late and said, "Okay, let's stop talking about it today. You can go and eat."
"Thank you, Mr. Chen, for your teaching."
Lin Qian stood up and bowed to Dr. Chen.
Lin Qian then packed up various medicinal materials, walked out of the pharmacy, turned around and closed the door gently.
Every time Dr. Chen explains various medical knowledge to Lin Qian, he feels very content and has a sense of unfinished learning.
He was very satisfied with Lin Qian.
Lin Qian is the most talented and understanding apprentice he has ever encountered in his life.
As long as it was what he said, Lin Qian could remember it firmly in his mind.
Even more than just remembering, Lin Qian can also touch other people and draw inferences about other cases.
How could he be dissatisfied with such an apprentice? Dr. Chen felt that Lin Qian could surpass him in medical skills within a few years.
Previously, Dr. Chen felt that it was nonsense for Hall Master Liu to ask him to train a doctor within a year.
But with Lin Qian's amazing performance, it's not a bad idea to train a doctor in one year.
Thinking again of the scene when he taught his children and grandchildren medical skills, Dr. Chen couldn't help but frown deeply.
He took the trouble to teach his grandson medical skills, but his grandson just couldn't remember it. Even if he remembered it at the time, he would forget everything when he woke up the next day.
It's like playing the harp to a cow, it's like rotten wood that cannot be carved.
"If Ping'er has half of Xiao Lin's talent, or even 20 to 30 percent of Xiao Lin's talent, I am confident that I can teach Ping'er to become a qualified doctor."
"Alas!
It's a pity that Ping'er is so stupid. His medical talent is not as good as mine at all, just like his father. "
Doctor Chen shook his head, sighed, and walked out of the room.
After Lin Qian left the medicine refining hall, he first went to the canteen to have lunch, and then practiced the Shadowless Needle in the woods.
The Shadowless Needle is about to break through to the third level, so his focus is temporarily on practicing the Shadowless Needle.
...
The five-story tower of Chuan Gong Hall.
Lin Qian was reading books in the main hall.
In the main hall, there are not only various martial arts secret books, but also some common sense books recording martial arts practice.
Lin Qian was looking through these books. There were records on the distribution of acupuncture points and meridians on the human body, records on the different changes in the body at each stage of breaking through the body quenching realm, books on some exotic flowers and plants, and biographies of some predecessors' travels.
Lin Qian looked through all the books but couldn't find what he wanted to know.
In desperation, Lin Qian turned to the bookshelf where the martial arts secret books were kept.
Although this was not Lin Qian's first time here, seeing these martial arts secrets again made him excited and he wished he could learn them all.
It's a pity that I can only think about it.
Seeing that the time was almost up, Lin Qian headed towards the door of the hall.
Since the last time he came here, he was scolded by Elder Situ for coming out too late.
Lin Qian specifically asked someone to inquire about this. The place was closed at five o'clock in the afternoon, and the old man at the entrance of the hall was called Elder Situ by his disciples.
Seeing that there were no other disciples around, Lin Qian walked towards Elder Situ.
"Hey, isn't this the boy practicing embroidery needlework?"
"What? Are you not satisfied with your embroidery needle training? Are you planning to switch to this technique and continue to relax?"
Elder Situ seemed to be concentrating with his eyes closed, but every move around him was under his control.
Situ ChangHe had noticed Lin Qian for a long time, and he still had an impression of Lin Qian.
